nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' of contract ParkShiba, set to 'Park Shiba' in the constructor.
Public string state variable 'symbol' of contract ParkShiba, set to 'PShiba' in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' set to 18 in the constructor.
Public uint256 state variable '_totalSupply' holding the total token supply, minted entirely to the deployer.
Mapping(address => uint) 'balances' tracking token balances of each account.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) 'allowed' storing ERC20 allowances.
ParkShiba constructor: initializes name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and assigns the whole supply to msg.sender, emitting a Transfer event.
totalSupply() view function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)], performing an unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view function returning the balance of the given address.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view function returning the remaining allowance.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) sets the caller's allowance for a spender and emits Approval.
transfer(address to, uint tokens) moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) moves tokens using the caller's allowance, updating balances and allowed.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure function returning a+b with an overflow check (require(c >= a)).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure function returning a-b with an underflow check (require(b <= a)).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure function returning a*b with an overflow check.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure function returning a/b with a divide-by-zero check.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address used for minting, allowances and balance debits.
Raw subtraction '_totalSupply - balances[address(0)]' in totalSupply() performed without SafeMath, an unchecked arithmetic operation.
safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) in transfer(), an arithmetic operation on user-supplied amount guarded only by the SafeMath require.
safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) in transfer(), an arithmetic operation crediting a user-supplied destination.
safeSub(balances[from], tokens) in transferFrom(), debiting an arbitrary 'from' address.
safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) in transferFrom(), decreasing the caller's allowance.
safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) in transferFrom(), crediting the destination balance.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' used by balanceOf and allowance as the account to query.
Parameter 'spender' used by allowance and approve as the delegate address.
Parameter 'tokens' (uint amount) used by approve, transfer and transferFrom; fully attacker-controlled.
Parameter 'to' (destination address) used by transfer and transferFrom.
Parameter 'from' (source address) used by transferFrom.
Parameter 'a', first operand of the SafeMath functions.
Parameter 'b', second operand of the SafeMath functions.
Named return variable 'balance' of balanceOf.
Named return variable 'remaining' of allowance.
Named return variable 'success' of approve, transfer and transferFrom.
Named return variable 'c' holding the result of safeAdd/safeSub/safeMul/safeDiv.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the string literal 'Park Shiba' into state variable name.
Constructor writes the string literal 'PShiba' into state variable symbol.
Constructor sets decimals to 18.
Constructor assigns the total supply of 100000000000000000000000000000 to _totalSupply.
Constructor mints the entire supply into balances[msg.sender].
msg.sender receives the initial minted balance in the constructor.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], keying state on the untrusted caller address.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], using the untrusted caller as the source of funds.
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender], so the caller address determines spending authority.
totalSupply reads the state variable _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] and subtracts it from _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried account.
allowance reads the allowed mapping for the owner/spender pair.
approve writes the allowance into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer updates both the sender and recipient entries of the balances mapping.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping for both from and to.
transferFrom decreases the allowance stored in the allowed mapping.
totalSupply executes the unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
transfer performs safeSub on balances[msg.sender] and tokens.
transfer performs safeAdd on balances[to] and tokens.
transferFrom performs safeSub on balances[from] and tokens.
transferFrom performs safeSub on allowed[from][msg.sender] and tokens.
transferFrom performs safeAdd on balances[to] and tokens.
transfer delegates its balance debit to the safeSub function.
transfer delegates its balance credit to the safeAdd function.
transferFrom calls safeSub for the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
The transfer debit operation is executed by SafeMath.safeSub.
The transfer credit operation is executed by SafeMath.safeAdd.
The transferFrom source debit is executed by SafeMath.safeSub.
The allowance decrement is executed by SafeMath.safeSub.
The transferFrom destination credit is executed by SafeMath.safeAdd.
safeSub result is written back into balances[msg.sender] inside transfer.
safeAdd result is written back into balances[to] inside transfer.
safeSub result is written back into balances[from] inside transferFrom.
safeSub result is written back into allowed[from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
safeAdd result is written back into balances[to] inside transferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenOwner is only meaningful as the lookup key of balanceOf/allowance and should be folded into those core functions.
spender is the delegate target written by approve and is not an independent semantic entity.
tokens is the attacker-controlled amount consumed by the transfer/transferFrom arithmetic operations.
to is simply the credit destination parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
from is only used as the debit source and allowance owner inside transferFrom.
a is the first operand of the SafeMath helpers and carries no standalone meaning.
b is the second operand of the SafeMath helpers and carries no standalone meaning.
balance is the named return slot of balanceOf and collapses into the function node.
remaining is the named return slot of allowance and collapses into the function node.
success is the boolean return slot of approve/transfer/transferFrom and has no independent state.
c is the temporary result holder of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers and merges into them.
